//testing: This repository uses NO pytest. Every test file is a hand-rolled check()/skip() harness executed directly (python test_*.py), and CI discovers them by glob and runs them the same way. Run tests from the Run and Debug panel instead; see .vscode/launch.json.
//path: The package is not pip-installed, so the repo root must be on PYTHONPATH for both the language server and any terminal.
